summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Moonshot Stock Picker app. All three new features working perfectly: dismiss buttons, stock stacking (up to 10), and Dense/Expand view toggle.
passed_tests: Access gate authentication with MOONSHOT code
Search and add stocks (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
Stock stacking functionality - multiple stocks display one below the other
Dismiss button functionality in spacious view
Dense view toggle - switches to compact table layout
Dense view displays all required columns: Ticker, Price, Change, Day Open, Day High, Day Low, Market Cap, P/E, 52W High, 52W Low, Volume, Actions
Expand view toggle - button text changes from 'Dense' to 'Expand' correctly
Dismiss functionality from Dense view (X button in Actions column)
Max 10 stocks limit enforcement with proper warning message
Real-time stock data display with proper formatting
Key Stats section with all 9 metrics
Categories section collapse when stocks are added
Responsive UI with proper styling and animations
